violaciones.ayuda: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color

nodos.resumen:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 1.17:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #2997ff, surrounding text: #a1a1a6)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text
